label: October 5–11, 2026
intro: Chinatown lights up for the Vegetarian Festival from Friday — and Thor can bang his first proper drum kit midweek!
weekday_note: A drum trial lesson at Yamaha or Rockademy is the weekday highlight — Thor will talk about it for weeks.

activities.title: Vegetarian Festival — Yaowarat Chinatown
activities.date: Friday October 9 – Sunday October 11 (festival runs Oct 9–18)
activities.location: Yaowarat Road, Chinatown, Bangkok (MRT Hua Lamphong or Wat Mangkon)
activities.price: Free entry — just buy street food!
activities.why: Lanterns, gold-and-red decorations, dragon processions, and hundreds of street food stalls. A wild sensory adventure that Thor will never forget. The atmosphere at night is electric.
activities.tip: Go at 5–6 PM before it gets really packed. Try the vegan coconut desserts and tofu skewers. Keep Thor on your shoulders in the thickest crowds — Yaowarat gets very busy but it's all festive energy.

activities.title: Drum Trial Lesson — Yamaha Music School
activities.location: Yamaha Music School — multiple Bangkok branches (Sukhumvit / Asok area)
activities.why: Thor is obsessed with drums — let him sit behind a real kit with a proper instructor. Yamaha does great kids programs and Thor is perfectly in the right age range to start.
activities.tip: Call your nearest Yamaha branch and ask for a 30-min kids drum trial. Branches near Sukhumvit make it easy. He'll be tapping to a beat by the end.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink — CentralWorld
activities.location: The Rink, Floor 2 Zone Forum, CentralWorld (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.price: ~450 THB/session weekend (1.5 hrs, skate rental included)
activities.why: Thor's favourite — glide, fall, laugh, repeat. Practice penguins available for balance.
activities.tip: Early Saturday morning is the least crowded. Combine with a Vegetarian Festival evening the same day for the ultimate Saturday.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum — Chatuchak
activities.location: Children's Discovery Museum, 810 Kamphaeng Phet 4 Rd, Chatuchak (BTS Mo Chit)
activities.why: Thor's dream — construction zone, science experiments, dinosaur dig sandbox, water play. Free and endlessly fun for a curious 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Great for a mid-week outing. Bring spare clothes for the water play zone. Combine with Chatuchak Park for a picnic after.

activities.title: National Science Museum Day Trip (Rangsit)
activities.location: National Science Museum, Pathum Thani (~45 min from Bangkok by car or Grab)
activities.why: Multiple massive buildings of hands-on tech and science — robots, engineering, natural history. Thor can build, experiment, and explore for a full day. Far better than the smaller city museums.
activities.tip: Take a Grab car (~350 THB each way). Arrive early. Bring snacks and a packed lunch since the café is small. Allow at least 3 hours minimum.
